prompt: The button click handler performs a 5-second network call. What is the problem?
choices: label.setText() requires the text to be a number
The 5-second call blocks the EDT, freezing the entire GUI
explanation: ActionListeners run on the EDT. A long-running call blocks all GUI events, making the window unresponsive. Fix: run the network call in a background thread (SwingWorker or Thread), then update the label on the EDT with SwingUtilities.invokeLater().
